evidence:
Source review of the frozen candidate finds no confirmed duplicate grade, subsumption or incompatible product demand for row 28. Parsed all five judge files: 80 Functional, 6 Polish, 6 Visual and one criterion per gate; the Functional prompt contains 22 named protocols. All 34 frozen rule-file hashes match the manifest, and the task files cited below match their manifest hashes. The root REVIEW_POLICY is hash-bound in engine_inputs and matches; it overrides the historical whole-flow exception. References below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r1/task/ unless stated otherwise.

Functional prompt.md:9,25,98-112 explicitly makes protocols shared evidence collection rather than all-legs scores: 'controls are shared facts, not inherited verdicts.' The actual owners support that instruction. functional/judge.toml:45-77 and prompt.md:148-182 separate stopping old handlers, preserving the actual completed/last-good picture, and later execution, with independent completed-render and immediate-handler fallbacks. S02 global freshness reuses S04 setter/readback facts but expressly does not require cancellation timing (judge.toml:35,63; prompt.md:182). Error message, source line, rollback and recovery have different observations, including JS versus full-document and synchronous versus callback/rejection paths (judge.toml:150-231,374-399,465-483). Successful duration and terminal duration own distinct run states (259,406); shared output markers are supporting controls, not duplicate console-stream grades. Auto-run's debounce, already-off behavior, pending cancellation, idle manual Run, manual consumption of a pending edit and document switching test different transitions (273-294,490-497; prompt.md:394-403).

Persistence owners are distinct in both event and observable. S21 round-trip fields, browser reload and S22 process restart are separate guarantees. S23 current updates supply fidelity evidence and the successful control for stale refusal, whereas refusal/unchanged saved state, exact dirty fields/feedback, and deliberate reapplication get separate owners (judge.toml:322,329,336-357,455; prompt.md:439-444). S37 differentiates snapshot fidelity after Saves, read-only inspection state, no execution during inspection, a deliberate restore, repeated committed-attempt acknowledgment, browser reload, stale-restore enforcement, and dirty-editor feedback (judge.toml:504-553; prompt.md:465-472). Retaining intervening snapshots during Restore is evidence of that operation's non-destructive result, not a second grade for the earlier Save snapshot observation. The controlled lost-response UI retry and request retries establish the same attempt-deduplication promise; ordinary restore field fidelity is explicitly excluded from that retry check (prompt.md:470). S38 paired races test simultaneous admission/history atomicity, independently of sequential stale refusal, and S22 distinguishes restart survival of current records, history, attempt receipts and valid later writing (prompt.md:429-433,476-479).

Cross-dimension overlaps are bounded by ownership. Gates establish basic execution and shared storage prerequisites with zero reward mass; their setup is not repeated for score (gates/render/judge.toml:27; gates/constraints/judge.toml:29; functional/prompt.md:5; frozen template scoring.toml). Polish measures names, keyboard reach, focus, actual navigation and understandable workspace surfaces, with separate results after failures (polish/judge.toml:32-68; prompt.md:45-51). Functional editor monospace/highlighting presence is not the Visual degree-of-readability judgment. Visual prompt.md:17-29 assigns desktop font defects and geometry defects to separate owners, prohibits recycling an observation into hierarchy/craft/responsiveness, and assigns mobile operability/clipping to Polish. Visual responsive composition is explicitly separate (visual/judge.toml:99-104). No pair requires opposing preview states: an active completed preview remains interactive, while a stopped/restored picture may be static (app_context.md:18; functional/prompt.md:17).

Adversarial source challenges: an app that refuses stale Saves but discards the dirty editor earns refusal credit and loses only draft-preservation credit; an app that performs a first restore but creates a fresh revision for every retry can earn history_restore while failing restore_retry; a sequentially correct server that admits both simultaneous writes fails the race outcomes. An app that only paints a preserved picture cannot obtain cancellation credit without a working matching control. Conforming alternatives such as static restored pictures, proactively disabled stale operations with useful feedback, native/composite keyboard controls, non-unit revision increments and different layouts/routes are explicitly accepted (prompt.md:17,19,21,463; polish/prompt.md:45-49), so these alternatives do not create contradictory requirements. These are reasoned counterexamples, not executed fixtures. No browser/provider run was performed for this semantic row; no Oracle/model/portal score or full judge-duration claim is made. Runtime-required clearances remain separate and are not waived by this Pass.
